programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - 2 Years (Day), University of Calcutta
programs.feeNote: MBA (Day) Admission Brochure 2027-29 course-fee chart: Semester 1 Rs 2,45,000 (Rs 2,15,000 + refundable library caution deposit Rs 5,000 + refundable security deposit Rs 5,000 + student activity fee Rs 20,000) + Semesters 2, 3 and 4 Rs 1,95,000 each = Rs 8,30,000. Same total in the institute's 'Break-up of Student Fees (2026 onwards)' (admission 12,000 + development 12,000 + tuition 1,91,000 per semester etc.). Includes Rs 10,000 refundable deposits; hostel not included. University of Calcutta registration/migration fees extra.
programs.intakeNote: Seat count not stated in the MBA (Day) brochure or fee pages.
programs.placementNote: Official 'MBA (Day) Placement Snapshot (2024-2025)' PDF (linked as 'MBA(Day) Placement Report 2025' on IISWBM's placement-reports page): highest domestic package Rs 16 LPA, average Rs 8 LPA, median Rs 9 LPA (median above average as published), 60 companies, 16 first-time recruiters. Batch size and audit not stated.

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting on CAT score
selectionProcess.detail: IISWBM obtains applicants' CAT scores from the IIM admission committee; candidates above a cut-off mark are called for GD/PI. Application form (Rs 1,500) online or offline; last date of issue and receipt 17 Dec 2026.

selectionProcess.name: Group Discussion and Personal Interview
selectionProcess.detail: At IISWBM, Kolkata, mid-March 2027; final list prepared strictly on merit. Eligibility: 3-year bachelor's degree with minimum 50% aggregate (45% SC/ST/NC-OBC/PwD).

keyDates.notes: MBA (Day) 2027-29 (52nd batch): last date of issue & receipt of application form 17 Dec 2026; GD, interview & result mid-March 2027; session begins 1st week of July 2027. Admission through CAT (Nov 2026).

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; 101-125 band not checked
